enchantments.What it do:
Attacks deal +5❤️ to enemies with a forbidden name but -5❤️ damage otherwise.
**Forbidden Names: Names containing "Doug", "Greg", "Jacob", Charolette", "Nathan", "Watson", or "broace".**
All loaded projectiles are fired in a tight volley, with arrows fired as 2❤️ damage fangs.
Charged attacks against full health entities or within 0.3 seconds of recharging deal +1-2 hearts of damage and recharge 10% faster.
Explosive entities can be sheared to _defuse_ them, dropping their explosive as an item and pacifying them if applicable.
Attacks apply 4-8 seconds of freezing, stacking with each attack and capping at 20 seconds.

Blasts deal -8-40% damage and -15–75% knockback.
> **Runecrafting Bonus**: Blasts instead deal -75% damage, then you siphon the shrapnel to form a 1❤ Absorption _blast shield_, granting knockback immunity and 25% damage reduction while the shield holds.
The spear enters a power phase 1.5 seconds into its charge which lasts 1 second and deals +2-4❤️ damage.
The first jump within 1 second of changing charge phases launches you forward.

Each attack _revs the chainsaw_, up to 4 times, after which you _berserk_ for 2 seconds, over which you shred enemies in front of or around you for 12❤️ while gaining 40% speed and melee damage immunity.

While gliding, sneaking causes you to shoot a dragon fireball, and colliding with terrain causes you to warp through it to the next open space.
While gliding near an Ender Crystal, you regenerate health.
Shots **Plague** enemies for 4-8 seconds. Plagued enemies have Wither I and on death will spread Plague stacks to the 1-3 closest enemies after a short delay.
Projectiles bypass invulnerability frames.

Fire and lava deal 8-40% less damage and you burn for 15-75% less time. 
> **Runecrafting Bonus**: You take -25% damage from burning enemies, and their unarmed attacks no longer ignite you.
You are slowed 60% less while drawing a shot.

You survive death at 0.5 hearts, cleansing negative effects and shedding a decoy tail which draws in distractible enemies for 10 seconds, during which you stealth and gain 80% speed. This can’t occur again until you fully heal.
Fall damage is reduced by -25-50%. Double sneaking while airborne performs a rapid downward stomp. Upon landing, the shockwave deals 50% of the initial damage to enemies within 5 blocks.

While drawn, the bow pulls items to you and small entities into its tesseract. Mobs fired from the tesseract deal their attack damage as bonus damage. You can fire without any ammo available, releasing a 3❤️ base damage energy shot.
Upon preparing a throw, enemies you _behold _are briefly slowed 40%._ _If they are below half health, they are **stunned** instead.
When the Void damages you, it spits you back upwards and grants you 5 minutes of stacking Luck. You can anger Wardens one additional time before they unburrow.
_Throws_ and _riptides_ create an undercurrent which pushes away enemies within 5 blocks and slows them by 40% for 1 second.
This item disappears upon death rather than dropping.
Shots fire a 9-block long and 4.5 block wide cylinder for 9❤️ damage, applying 9 seconds of freezing and burning.
Right-clicking these leggings while wearing them opens their pockets, a storage inventory with 18 slots.
Sweeps even when no target is hit directly.

- **Eclipses** the R.E.D. armor. You instead can read curse books, _sacrificing_ health to cast powerful **eldritch spells** which mark targets and **corrupt **your next punch. You can punch marked enemies from any range to siphon the mark and refund part of the _sacrifice_.
- Sneak-right-click with a curse book to morph it into a _cursed tome_ which can hold 5 curse books.
- **Eclipse: **The behavior of the eclipsed object is replaced while wearing this Aphelion.

enchantments.What it do:
Enemies targeting a nearby spouse are **scorned**, letting you lunge at them from afar, _but_ if a spouse dies in combat you wither away unless you enact **reckless vengeance** against their killer.
> **Scorned**: 
> - Swing at them while within 32 blocks to lunge. 
> - Your first strike sates 1 hunger and grants 50% attack speed for 7 seconds. - Your strikes heal the targeted spouse for 15% of damage dealt. 
> **Reckless Vengeance: **Gain +20% speed toward the target. You can only have one vengeance target at a time. The wither is only cleansed upon killing your target.

- Creatures viewed through this spyglass slowly shrink. Creatures shrunk to minimum size become passive.
- Enemies with higher max health shrink slower.
While above 75% health, you take -50% damage and gain a burst of speed when taking damage.
Being struck or taking fall damage while holding this bow in your main hand automatically fires a fully charged shot. Firing a damaging projectile puts Hair-Trigger on a 1-second cooldown.
Once equipped, items with this curse can only be unequipped via death.
Smash attacks emit a sound wave which applies stacking _resonance_ to other enemies within 10 blocks, dealing 1❤️ sonic damage and 0.25 seconds stunning per stack.

More entities can be sheared periodically for resources.
- **Blazes:** Blaze Rods
- **Chickens and Parrots:** Feathers
- **Creepers:** Gunpowder
- **Ghasts:** Ghast Tears
- **Glow Squids: **Glow Ink
- **Guardians: **Prismarine Shards and Crystals
- **Magma Cubes: **Magma Cream
- **Phantoms:** Phantom Membranes
- **Shulkers:** Shulker Shells
- **Skeletons:** Bone Meal
- **Slimes:** Slime Balls
- **Sniffers:** Moss
- **Spiders and Striders:** String
- **Squids: **Ink
- **Wither Skeletons: **Coal

**Eclipses** the Runic Tome. When you would cast the Void, Gusts, Kinesis, or Sparks spells, you instead cast **Great Red Spot**.
- **Great Red Spot**: A large elliptical lightning storm forms around you for 25 seconds. It pulls in and suffocates enemies, increasing in intensity at the center, which instead deals more frequent void damage. Costs 125 XP.

enchantments.What it do:
- This trident attacks 10% slower for **1-2❤️ damage.**
- Throws are _heavier_, falling faster but dealing **+2-♾️❤️ damage, **increasing linearly with distance fallen.

You approach combat in 10-second _battle cycles, _each with 10 _Aegis_🛡️. You must use 1🛡️ to shoot or manually attack, or you can double tap movement keys while blocking to spend 🛡️ to execute _battle actions_:
- W: (3🛡️) Enter **warfare stance** for 3 attacks.
- A: (2🛡️) Stealth and prepare an **ambush**.
- S: (2-4🛡️) Petrify those facing you with the Gorgon **stare.**
- D: (4🛡️) Plant a **decoy trap zone** at the target area.

- **Warfare Stance: **Strike in a cone behind the target, dealing +2-5❤️ base damage to all targets scaling with how unarmored each target is.
- **Ambush: **Stealth and gain 20% speed for 3 seconds. If you exit stealth by attacking, you critically strike for 1.5x base damage and shred 50% of the target's armor for 5 seconds.
- **Stare: **Stuns for 3 seconds, costing 2-4🛡️ for 1-3+ affected enemies. Players always cost 3🛡. Attacks which break petrification deal +2-5❤️ executing base damage, +2❤️ per parry this battle cycle.
- **Decoy Trap Zone: **A temporary 4x4 zone centered on a 5❤️ decoy which is hidden from other players and attracts mobs. Enemies who enter the zone or hit the decoy are parried and automatically attacked by you, ignoring the range.

Sneaking while jumping performs an upward rocket boost and resets accumulated fall distance. You can perform 2-3 rocket boosts before landing.
> Fall damage is reduced by 2 hearts.
Surplus seeds and poisonous potatoes dropped by harvested crops are automatically composted.
This rod _sears_ 30-50% of caught fish, doubling restored hunger and sell price, and can fish in lava, doubling the _sear_ chance.
Upon ascending to the maximum height from this mace's boosting enchantment, it releases a sheet of ice which falls forward onto targets below, dealing 4♥️ freezing damage and 8 seconds of frostbite.
Untargeted swings convert accumulated smash damage into an equivalent amount of _torque_. Standard mace attacks deal bonus lightning damage equal to 25-35% of _torque_.

You can form lifelong **contracts**_ _with humanoids with raw gold, _but_ if ever you don’t re-up their contract, they **betray** you.
> **Contracts**: Contractors gain vanishing, unbreakable golden copies of your gear, reset to their standard max health, and unshakably follow you between worlds. You can contract 4 creatures, but not those with keywords.
> **Betrayal**: Contractors who **betray** you gain attack damage, speed, knockback resistance, and their contract cannot be resumed.
You reflect a sonic wave at entities who shoot you which stuns them for 0.25-1 seconds upon arrival.
Strikes prepare a **_broadside cannon, _**up to 2-4 cannons. Thrown hits signal each cannon to fire an explosive cannonball **towards enemies** in the direction of the throw.

Charged attacks grant 1 stack, up to 4. At 4 stacks, right-click to consume all stacks and Howl, releasing a sonic wave that strikes enemies in a 6-block cylinder for 75% damage. If your offhand weapon is Howling, it also strikes them for 25% damage.

- Double sneaking calls or dismisses your chosen **spirit** **mount**, defaulting to your **spirit** **wolf**.
- While mounted, you apply **moonlight** to the closest enemy. **Moonlit** enemies periodically glow, take +2-4♥️ magic damage from headshots, and ranged kills collect their loot and heal your mount 1♥️.

While gliding, sneaking causes you to echolocate, highlighting mobs within 40 blocks and granting night vision for 10 seconds. 
While in light levels of 4 or less, mobs only detect you from 60-25% of their usual distance.
While gliding, taking Void damage wraps you around the world height limit.
When catching fish, you may reel in up to 1-3 additional fish.
While sprinting, you can warp through 1-block thick walls.
While worn, you are 12.5% smaller and lose 12.5% attack damage.

**Auto-harvesting** crops has a 33% chance to drop an experience orb.
> Auto-harvesting: Right-click a fully grown crop to automatically harvest and replant it.
While worn, you take triple fall damage.
On-kill, gain a _tempest charge._ Right click to expend it to dash forward 5 blocks or to the first enemy, then slice for 2-4❤️ damage.

You reflect projectiles and take -25% damage from them. 
Sneak punching the block below you closes your shell until you stop sneaking. While your shell is closed, you take -25% damage and are immune to knockback, jumping teleports you to a random nearby location, and fired arrows become shulker bullets. If they hit a target who was already levitating, the levitation is cleansed instead, but the bullet and the target’s fall both deal 4x damage.
Collisions form a pressure bubble which collapses after 1 second, pulling in enemies within 5 blocks, briefly stunning and dealing 2.5 ❤ suffocation damage.
Your tames’ and summons’ attacks benefit from combat enchantments on your held melee weapon, but your attacks no longer do.
Horn blows emit a sonic boom which moves forward 10 blocks, dealing 2♥️ sonic damage, vaporizing sediments and cobwebs, and breaking bamboo, flowers, and grasses.
You walk 25-50% faster on ice and snow blocks, and freeze the ground beneath you in a 3-4 block radius while walking, converting powdered snow to snow and temporarily converting water to frosted ice.

Smash attacks release a _bubble_ which envelops you for 4-8 seconds, blocking damage while you rise 4 blocks per second with increased aerial mobility. The bubble pops early if you sneak or it blocks 10♥️ damage.

**Eclipses** the Grasshopper. It instead can be continuously charged, during which it creates an _icy jet stream_ in your target direction, freezing and pushing yourself along with any enemies and projectiles within.
- **Eclipse: **The behavior of the eclipsed object is replaced while wearing this Aphelion.
Increased underwater mobility and compatibility with other enchantments. No longer exclusive with Channeling.
While gliding, colliding with a wall deals 40-80% less damage and repulses you backwards.
Parries stack _fortification_ 3 times. Once stacked, you consume them to gain 3❤️ Absorption for 3 seconds.

**Eclipses **Howling. Your Howl instead requires 7 stacks and intiates an _icy riptide_, freezing enemies you pass through for 2 seconds and striking for 75% damage. If your offhand is Howling, it also strikes for 25% damage.
- **Eclipse: **The behavior of the eclipsed object is replaced while wearing this Aphelion.

While charging `faster than 15 m/s`, slain enemy drops are atomized, often converting to _primordial dust_, which can then be crafted with `crystals` or socketing gems to duplicate them.

`Faster than 15 m/s: Effects will play while you are charging fast enough to atomize items`
`Crystals: Lapis Lazuli, Nether Quarts, Amethyst Shards, Prismarine Shards, Diamonds, and Emeralds.`
Projectile hits release ropes which pull in enemies within 5 blocks and slow them by 20% for 2 seconds.
Impacts chain up to 3 times, auto-throwing at the nearest unchained enemy within 12 blocks for 35-75% of the original impact’s damage.
An item with a different Paradigm can be inserted into this one to gain only its positive effects, but your maximum health is reduced by 40%.

Your swings fire as piercing waves, and you can hover at full health, _but_ you strike yourself, bypassing armor, when your waves miss.

```
Waves: Weapons with lower attack speed fire wider waves and ones with higher range fire faster moving waves.
```

```
Hover: Swing directly up to toggle the hover. It disables once you witness your health fall below full.
```

**Auto-harvesting** crops refills a small amount of hunger. If your hunger is full, you gain saturation instead.
> Auto-harvesting: Right-click a fully grown crop to automatically harvest and replant it.
**Well-timed **attacks deal +1❤️ damage and stack _momentum_, stacking infinitely for +4-8% attack speed per stack.
Creatures view through this spyglass for 1 second glow and become magically tracked. Projectiles home in on tracked entities.
Kills leave behind the victim's soul as an inert _cinder wisp_. Wisps explode when caught in a smash attack or explosion, igniting and dealing 5❤️ explosion damage in a 5-block radius.

The first target you charge is _impaled_ for 2 seconds and held before you. Ending the charge flings the _impaled_ a distance and **stuns **them and enemies the collide with, both based on your speed.

Now works vs. any mob in water/rain regardless of if it's aquatic
Throws fly straight and pull enemies, then slam down and form a suffocating whirlpool.
Bashing causes you to rapidly dash forward, pushing all enemies you collide with along the dash, then stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
Attacks reduce the duration of negative effects by 10-30% (minimum 1-3 seconds).
Returns earlier and at a faster speed. Returns even if it falls in the void.
While worn, you are far more likely to be struck by lightning during thunderstorms.

- While your world's overworld is thunderstorming, strikes that drop a **boss** below any 25% health threshold detonate a large, **stunning** _tempest flare_ for 10♥️ lightning damage. 
- Once per thunderstorm, each boss drops a **tempest chest** when slain, 10% of which contain their head.
After an attack, you can double-tap a movement key to hop in that direction, during which you are invulnerable.
**Parries** stack **_static_** 3 times. Once stacked, your next attack discharges in a cone, dealing 2❤️ damage and **stunning** for 2 seconds.
Charged attacks immediately execute targets left below 5% health. Executed targets are 3.5x more likely to drop their head.

You can **hand-forge** _artisan weapons_ using up to 2 materials and 1 gem. They're unenchantable and low durability, but deal high damage, apply bonus effects per-component, and 🔨**_strike the iron_**_ _every 10th hit, amplifying effects in +2 radius:

- Stone: Attacks stun briefly or 🔨**for 2 seconds.**

- Diamond: 🔨**Striking the iron **stacks forged gems stats twice.

- **Hand-forge: **Right-click a weapon material onto a stick in your inventory to forge a sword, or shift-right-click to forge an axe. Further materials and gems can be right-clicked onto an artisan weapon to forge them in. Forged gems are dropped when the weapon breaks.
These leggings gain a _belt_, a 9-slot item inventory. Activating the leggings swaps the contents of their belt and your hotbar.

You take -50% knockback, deal +25% knockback. Gain +2❤️ max HP.
You can give zombie villagers a poppy to cure them without applying Weakness.
Charges forcibly dash to Charybdis, briefly liquefying terrain. Jabs near the whirlpool pull in enemies and execute at 10% HP, sating 1 hunger.

After a **parry**, your next attack automatically critically strikes.

While digging, this tool randomly changes which block set it is effective against.
While worn, you drown twice as fast.
Right clicking in an open space rips open a temporary Nether portal. Doing this while sneaking opens an End portal instead.

Attacks stack **_judgement_** 3 times. Once stacked, right-clicking slams your sword down at the target area where it calls a **_divine strike,_** dealing 3-6❤️ execute damage to enemies and refunding 1 **_judgement_** per enemy slain.

Every night you haven’t slept adds a Phantom to your Phantom Horde, up to 10.
While gliding, colliding with an enemy deals 2-7 hearts of damage. When gliding at night, you summon your Phantom Horde, who fly with you and attack nearby enemies for the same damage.
Slain enemies have a chance, scaling with overkill damage, to be crushed into _primordial dust_, which can be crafted with crystals and socketing gems to duplicate them.
After sprinting while grounded for 1.5 seconds, you **Blitz**, gaining 20-40% speed until you stop sprinting.

Eating honey while gliding causes you to release pollen for 5 seconds, bonemealing crops below you in a 3-block radius.

**Eclipses **gem socketing. Instead, you form a rotating ring of moonlets upon entering combat. You have 6 moonlets 2❤️ which block hits from outside of your ring until destroyed. Your ring gains the following stats per socketed gem:

Taking at least 1❤️ damage at once lights your fuse for 2 seconds, ending in a fiery explosion which ignites and deals **1.5-6❤️ damage** to enemies within 5 blocks.

You gain +0.5 step height and can sense enemies via their **vibrations**, causing you to **anger**. Once fully angered, you gain the following effects:

Always slows for the full duration (1.5-3.5 seconds) and works against Shulkers.

Horn blows emit a sonic boom which expands to a 6-block radius, dealing 2❤️ sonic damage and detaching chorus flowers, amethyst clusters, pointed dripstone, and berries.

You gain Adrenaline for 10 seconds when dropping to 25% health. This slows nearby enemies, cuts damage-over-time effects to half speed, and grants you +40-80% speed, damage and damage reduction. This can’t occur again until you fully heal.

Attacks drain 0.5❤️ to deal +1❤️ damage.

Upon **blinking**, you engage in _divine trickery_, a brief stealth that empowers your next attack +2♥️, and create a _shortcut_ for 4 seconds that you can enter once to return to the other end. If the shortcut expires unused, you engage in divine trickery once more.
Landed projectiles become a flare, providing light which decays over 30 seconds. Enemies hit directly glow for 30 seconds instead.
Always procs consistently, and damage now scales linearly with total level (across armor pieces) rather than proc chance
Attacks **Plague**_ _enemies for 4-8 seconds. Plagued enemies have Wither I and on death will spread Plague stacks to the 1-3 closest enemies after a short delay.

You can _lumber_, moving 10% slower and gaining slow, **massive attacks**, _but_ lumbering replaces sprinting.

Attacks ignite the victim for 4-12 seconds.

Lit fires convert to soul fire.
Fired projectiles instantly arrive at your targeted location.

Your hunger bar acts as an additional secondary health bar, but consumed food is at best as filling as bread.

Shots apply 8 seconds of freezing, stacking with each shot and capping at 20 seconds.

You jump higher, take -25% fall damage, and bounce back up after taking fall damage.

While gliding, you gather _static charge_, and temporarily slow down while aiming ranged weapons. At full charge, your next fired projectile **becomes lightning**.
- **Becomes Lightning**: Lightning projectiles gain trueshot and strike lightning upon colliding. If it strikes an enemy, the lightning deals the same damage as the projectiles.
Viewing a portal through this spyglass instantly transports you through it.
Ignited TNT becomes a sticky blast charge which explodes in a 3x3x10 area in the ignition direction, leaving behind trace amounts of sand and gunpowder.
Durability drain removed.
Swinging with a round loaded pushes it to the _magazine_, which can hold 2 rounds. Upon firing, the most recent round in the _magazine_ is immediately reloaded.

- You can riptide while grounded without being wet.
- Whenever your riptide, you _ride the wave_, always traveling the full distance, at constant speed, and with full control of your direction, striking all nearby enemies along the way.

While airborne, right click to freeze and charge a mace throw, generating torque based on smash damage upon landing, then slam down to it, stunning enemies within 5 blocks. Standard attacks deal 25% of torque as chain lightning damage.
**Bashing** throws your shield up to 10 blocks, striking the first enemy hit for 4♥️ damage and briefly slowing by 20% before returning.

You have dominion over **_past_**,**_ present_**, and **_future_**, granting the following spell effects:
- **Past**: You _reflect_ after every 3rd spell cast, causing your next spell tome swing to recast your last spell at no XP cost.
- **Present**: You gain 25% runic spell power, and magic weapon kills collect loot and XP.
- **Future**: You can sneak swing a spell tome to _scry_, casting its rightmost spell regardless of your current selection.
**Bashing **causes you to rapidly dash forward 5 blocks while creating a shockwave which deflects projectiles in a wide arc.

- You can hand-brew potions by inserting water or ingredients into bottles.
- Your potions cause their targets **drunken revelry**, starting a _happy hour_ if applied repeatedly, during which 50% of used potions are not consumed.
    - **Drunken Revelry**: Grants +1❤️ attack damage for 10 seconds, nauseating briefly if applied to yourself or for the full duration if applied to enemies. Nauseated mobs randomly lose focus upon attacking and fire projectiles inaccurately.

Projectiles deal 8-40% less damage and apply `15-75%` less knockback. 
> **Runecrafting Bonus**: Negative potion effects from projectiles have -75% less duration.

Sneak right clicking an **appropriate resource block** attunes to it. Mining other appropriate blocks converts their drops into those of the attuned block at the **equivalent exchange rate**.
```
Pickaxes: All ores except Emerald and Ancient Debris.
Axes: All logs.
Shovels: Mycelium, Podzol, Clay, Red Sand, Soul Sand, and Mud.
Shears: All leaves.
```
> For example, a Diamond sells for 8x as much as Raw Gold, so mining Gole Ore while attuned to Diamond Ore has a 1/8 chance to drop a diamond, while mining Diamond Ore while attuned to Gold Ore drops 8 Raw Gold.
Shots deal +50% damage, collect loot, and don't cause vibrations. Shots overdrawn for 1 second _whisper_, homing in on enemies and dealing +25% sonic damage.
Grounded projectiles emit smoke for 10 seconds, preventing sight-reliant enemies from naturally detecting targets within. Enemies hit directly have their sight obscured for the same duration instead

- When applied to a tool, breaking a block instead breaks a random adjacent block.
- When applied to boots, your position periodically rounds.

**Auto-harvesting** crops automatically regrows them by 2-3 growth stages, capped at 1 below their max growth stage.
> Auto-harvesting: Right-click a fully grown crop to automatically harvest and replant it.
Charge strikes grant **+30-90% attack speed** on your next 3 jabs

The item breaks 5x slower.
> **Runecrafting Bonus**: The item is immune to destruction while dropped in the world. If the item would break, it instead drops to Unbreaking III and repairs 25% of its durability.
After attacking, if you lose no health while recharging, your next attack deals +2-4 hearts of armor-piercing damage and briefly slows the target.

Briefly after breaking a block, an aftershock temporarily cracks blocks in a 3x3 area. If an aftershock hits a cracked block, it is broken instead. Breaking blocks while sneaking does not trigger aftershocks.

valor.Name: Sanguine Phial
valor.Description: Grants stacks from kills in combat. Upon exiting combat, converts stacks to healing (0.1❤️ per stack). With 50+ stacks, also grants a random reward.

valor.Name: Guide to Terrestrial Taming
valor.Description:
A skill book which allows you to tame and ride the following land creatures:
- Sniffers: Spacebar to sniff, revealign treasures within 12 blocks. (❤️+ Torchflower Seeds)
- Goat: Low fall damage. Spacebar to jump high. (❤️+ Wheat)
- Panda: Spacebar to roll.(❤️+ Bamboo)
- Polar Bear: Spacebar to swipe for 5❤️ damage. (❤️+ Cod)

valor.Name: Headlamp
valor.Description: Emits a light at your head location, illuminating the area around you.

valor.Name: G.A.M.M.A.
valor.Description:
A spear with the mythical loot enchant Cyclotron:
- Cyclotron🌟: While charging faster than 15 m/s, slain enemy drops are atomized, often converting to primordial dust, which can then be crafted with crystals or socketing gems to duplicate them.

valor.Name: Abyssal
valor.Description:
Per Piece: +8 Mining Efficiency

Set Bonus (3+ Pieces):
- Grants permanent Night Vision.
- Mining no longer causes vibrations.
- Mining ore grants Abyssal Charge which can be spent by sneak jumping while looking down to Delve or up to Sense:
- Delve: Blink to the next lowest area. Costs 1-25 Charge. (1 per block traveled, caps at 25)
- Sense: Briefly reveal nearby ores. Costs 25 charge.

valor.Name: Bobblehead
valor.Description: Gain the Luck effect permanently while wearing your own head.

valor.Name: Fish Tags
valor.Description: Caught fish are tagged and released, instantly selling for slightly reduced silver and granting bonus experience based on the fish.

valor.Name: Iron Cicada Wings
valor.Description: A pair of elytra with 6 armor and 2 armor toughness.

valor.Name: Orbweaver
valor.Description:
Right click to launch a web which attaches to struck blocks or entities. Striking an entity pulls it towards you, while striking a block pulls you towards it.
*1 second cooldown*

valor.Name: Unsocket Armor
valor.Description: Removes all socketed gems from an armor piece.

valor.Name: Karru'Val
valor.Description:
A bow with the mythical damage enchantment Whispering🌟
- Whispering: Shots deal +50% damage, collect loot, and don't cause vibrations. Shots overdrawn for 1 second whisper, homing in on enemies and dealing +25% sonic damage.

valor.Name: Cerberus
valor.Description:
Cerberus is a crossbow, Hellhound's Maw, with the mythical spread enchant Tartarean Hellhound⭐, which transforms into Hellhound's Fang when swung.

- Tartarean Hellhound: All loaded projectiles are fired in a tight volley, with arrows fired as 2❤️ damage fangs.
- Hellhound's Fang deals 4❤️ base damage, and triples to projectiles loaded in Hellhound's Maw on every 3rd hit, up to 27 after 9 hits.

valor.Name: Windup Key
valor.Description: Right click an Iron Golem to ally it to you for 20 minutes. Can be used 4 times.

valor.Name: Training Weight
valor.Description: Items dropped by slain creatures are each converted to 1 XP.

valor.Name: Balloon Animal
valor.Description: When a tamed or summoned creature dies, it explodes, stunning enemies in a 5-block radius and dealing 10❤️ damage.

valor.Name: Chimaera
valor.Description:
Chimaera is a bow which splits into a wood and stone sword when swung. Sneak-right-click while holding both to reform the bow. Each applies a mark which the other can redeem to grant a 40% speed burst and apply bonus effects:
- Serpent's Fang🏹 redeems 2 seconds of venom.
- Lion's Claw⚔️ redeems 2x damage.
- Goat's Horn⚔️ redeems 2x knockback and a 1-second stun.

Venom: a rapid poison which heals you for 50% of the damage dealt.
Stun: halts an entity, preventing movement, attacks, and shots. Direct strikes break enemies out of stuns.

valor.Name: Transmog Helmet
valor.Description: Transmutes a regular helmet into a custom helmet which resembles any item.

valor.Name: Elytra Mode
valor.Description: Grants you Elytra Mode for 30 minutes.

valor.Name: Silver Springs Brochure
valor.Description: Grants a 35% discount on all Silver Springs Village vendor purchases.

valor.Name: Pumpkin Mask
valor.Description: Prevents Endermen from targeting you when looking at them. Reduces mob detection range by 20%.

valor.Name: Golf Club
valor.Description: Your attacks gain range, ignore some mob knockback resist, and deal double knockback to small targets.

valor.Name: Atlas
valor.Description: A book that can hold many maps. Sneak-right-click to open the Atlas. Right click a map stored in the Atlas to make the Atlas appear as that map when held.

valor.Name: Coffee Beans
valor.Description: Gain speed, haste, and double experience during sunrise.

valor.Acquisition (Non-Purchaseable): Converted from Film Reels to Corrupted Footage through the Boundary Shard system
valor.Name: Corrupted Footage
valor.Description: Corrupted Tome casts follow a specific spell sequence unique to each footage reel, but with halved XP costs and spell cooldowns.

valor.Name: Guide to Hazardous Taming
valor.Description:
A skill book which allows you to tame and ride the following dangerous creatures:
- Slime: Landing deals area damage, absorbing smaller slimes to permanently increase size and jump height. (❤️+ Slimeballs)
- Spider: Climb walls and walk through webs. (❤️+ String)
- Hoglin: Spacebar to swing, knocking up and dealing 3❤️ damage. (❤️+ Crimson Fungus)
- Ravager: Spacebar to roar, dealing 3❤️ damage and 5 blocks knockback in a 5-block radius. (❤️+ Emeralds)

valor.Name: Runic Compass
valor.Description: Periodically, after slaying an enemy in a Rune Locale, the compass identifies a nearby empowered enemy who always drops a rune.

valor.Name: Messina
valor.Description:
Messina is a trident, Charybdis, with the mythical trajectory enchant Whirlpool🌟 whose throws leave Scylla in your hand.

- Whirlpool🌟: Throws fly straight and pull enemies, then slam down and form a suffocating whirlpool.

- Scylla is a diamond spear with no minimum attack range and with the mythical dash enchant Man-Eater🌟. Charybdis can be collected, replacing Scylla, once no enemies are in its whirlpool.

- Man-Eater🌟: Charges forcibly dash to Charybdis, briefly liquefying terrain. Jabs near the whirlpool pull in enemies and execute at 10% HP, sating 1 hunger.

valor.Name: Umbral
valor.Description:
Per Piece: +8% Sneaking Speed

Set Bonus (3+ Pieces):
- Grants permanent Night Vision.
- While sneaking, enemies only detect you while facing you within 10 blocks.
- Ranged strikes grant Umbral Charge and deal +2❤️ damage while undetected or striking from behind. At full charge, you can sneak then double step backwards to enter Shadow Form for 3 seconds.

valor.Name: Film Reel
valor.Description: Runic Tome casts follow a specific spell sequence unique to each Reel, but with halved XP costs and spell cooldowns.

valor.Acquisition (Non-Purchaseable): Rarely replaces duped shiny gold coins
valor.Name: Old Minting Press
valor.Description: When a Shiny Gold Coin you flip duplicates, you have a 15% chance to receive a Mint Error Coin instead.

valor.Name: Guide to Aqueous Taming
valor.Description:
A skill book which allows you to tame and ride the following aquatic or liquid creatures:
- Turtle: Grants increased oxygen (❤️+ Seagrass)
- Dolphin: The fastest sea mount. (❤️+ Tropical Fish)
- Guardian: Spacebar shoots a laser at your target. (❤️+ Prismarine Crystals)
- Squid: Spacebar shoots ink, blinding enemies then dashing forward. (❤️+ Cod)

valor.Name: I.N.D.I.G.O.
valor.Description:
Per Piece: +25% Aerial Mobility, +2 Safe Fall Distance

Set Bonus (3+ Pieces):
Sneaking while looking directly up or down adjusts your gravity between 2x or -0.1x. Gravity resets to 1x when you deal combat damage, exceed the world height limit, or begin gliding.

valor.Name: Hourglass Sands
valor.Description: Cooldowns on utility items are reduced by 35%.

valor.Name: Mob Scarecrow
valor.Description:
Creates a scarecrow which denies spawns in a 20 meter radius. Feeding more Withered Hearts increases this radius by 10, up to a maximum of 50 meters.

Note: Some Withered Hearts may be lost when breaking a placed scarecrow.

valor.Name: mcMMO XP Boost
valor.Description: Doubles your mcMMO XP gains for 30 minutes.

valor.Name: Grasshopper
valor.Description:
Right click while near solid terrain to hop forward. Once airborne, you can right click again to reset your fall distance and briefly glide.

1 second cooldown

valor.Name: Ethereal
valor.Description:
Per Piece: +8% Sweeping Damage

Set Bonus (3+ Pieces):
- Grants permanent Night Vision.
- Your sweeping damage bonuses apply to all sweeping enchants.
- Strikes grant Ethereal Charge. At full charge, you become Ethereal, causing the next direct damage you take to be negated and trigger a 1-second stealth.

valor.Name: Prince Ruperts Drop
valor.Description: Your hazard enchantments activate with massive power when struck from behind.

valor.Name: Shiny Gold Coin
valor.Description: Right click to flip the coin. With luck, the coin may duplicate.

valor.Name: R.E.D.
valor.Description:
Per Piece: +1 Unarmed Attack Damage

Set Bonus (3+ Pieces):
You can consume enchanted books to scan their compatible enchants into the R.E.D. database. Activate the helmet to select enchants from the database to apply on every other punch, or on any other piece to change your Stance, causing every 3rd enchanted punch to apply bonus enchants:
- Chestplate: Applies one additional damage enchant.
- Leggings: Applies one additional sweeping enchant.
- Boots: Applies two additional aspect enchants.

valor.Name: Metal Detector
valor.Description: Junk items brushed out of suspicious sediments are replaced with scrap.

valor.Name: Infinite Bucket
valor.Description: An infinite water bucket.

valor.Name: Portable Hole
valor.Description:
Right clicking consumes 35 XP to carve an 8-block tunnel in the direction you're looking for 10 seconds
*6 second cooldown*

valor.Name: Runic Tome
valor.Description:
A spell tome with a 5-slot rune inventory. Sneak right click to open it, then right click an inserted rune to select it. Use the tome with the inventory closed to spend XP to cast that rune's spell. Use /rune to view the spell for each rune.
- Boundary Shards can turn Runic Tomes into Corrupted Tomes. Use /lexicon boundaries for more details.

valor.Name: Checkered Flag
valor.Description: Prevents the hunger effect from being applied and reduces exhaustion from movement by 50%.

valor.Name: Potion Launcher
valor.Description: Contains a 9-slot item inventory which can hold potions. Once loaded, right clicking fires the leftmost potion in the inventory.

valor.Acquisition (Non-Purchaseable): For purchase from one of the Silver Springs villager vendors.
valor.Name: Protein Powder
valor.Description: Drinking potions with effects grants +2 hunger.

valor.Name: Chicory
valor.Description: Animals you breed drop 5x more average XP and can be bred again 35% sooner.

valor.Name: Adventurer's Tricorne
valor.Description: Gain 500 Silver when opening loot chests of 250 Silver when slaying survival world bosses.

valor.Name: Mark of the Cult
valor.Description: Marks you as a target of the Runic Cultists. While in survival worlds, one of them will periodically hunt you down. Slaying them drops Runes, Bottles o' Enchanting, and Enchanted Books, which rarely may contain Runecrafted enchantments.

valor.Name: Supercell
valor.Description:
A mace with the mythical enchant Ragnarok🌟:
- Ragnarok: While airborne, right click to freeze and charge a mace throw, generating torque based on smash damage upon landing, then slam down to it, stunning enemies within 5 blocks. Standard attacks deal 25% of torque as chain lightning damage.

valor.Name: Juniper Sprig
valor.Description: When taking poison or wither damage, you have a 10-50% chance based on your alchemy level (and luck) to cleanse the effect and gain brief regeneration.

valor.Name: Spare Key
valor.Description: Your first charm slot can be modified even while your charms case is locked.

valor.Acquisition (Non-Purchaseable): Rarely drops in place of heads
valor.Name: Wishbone
valor.Description: Guarantees the next enemy you kill will drop their head, then destroys itself.

valor.Name: Bonus Charm Slot
valor.Description: Grants you an additional charm slot. Can be purchased 2 times.

valor.Name: Particle Wand
valor.Description:
Can be used to create particle effects in the world.
Left Click: Increase planned particle field radius
Sneak + Left Click: Decrease planned particle field radius
Right Click: Cycle through various available particles
Sneak + Right Click: Confirm field creation
Current Radius: Displays current particle field radius
Current Particle: Displays your currently selected particle

Using on an entity attaches the field to that entity.
Placed fields can be recollected by using a stick on them.

valor.Name: Chamomile Tea
valor.Description: Phantoms no longer hunt you due to insomnia.

valor.Name: Polaris
valor.Description:
Charge with light sources, can then be used to place light blocks.

Left Click: Adjust brightness. Sneak to decrease
Right Click: Place or absorb a light source.
Right Click (Inventory): Insert light-emitting items to add charge. Shift click to insert full stacks.
Double Sneak: Visualize nearby lights.

valor.Name: Silence Tonic
valor.Description: Use on an entity to silence them. Has 2 charges.

valor.Name: Time Capsule
valor.Description: Continuously grows in value while in a locked charms case. Right click to open and claim prizes based on the accumulated value.

valor.Name: I.R.I.D.E.S.C.E.N.T.
valor.Description:
A bow with the mythical ammo enchant Tesseract🌟:
- Tesseract: While drawn, the bow pulls items to you and small entities into its tesseract. Mobs fired from the tesseract deal their attack damage as bonus damage. You can fire without any ammo available, releasing a 3❤️ base damage energy shot.

valor.Name: Tip Jar
valor.Description: Animals you feed will tip you silver in return based on the food's value.

valor.Name: Pointy Hat
valor.Description: Witches no longer naturally target you, and will offer you unique trades when interacted with.

valor.Name: Revert Transmog
valor.Description: Transmutes a custom helmet back into a regular helmet.

valor.Name: Quickfuse Dynamite
valor.Description: Right Click to launch a piece of dynamite, which explodes after two seconds.

valor.Acquisition (Non-Purchaseable): For purchase from one of the Silver Springs villager vendors.
valor.Name: Bread Bowl
valor.Description: When eating soups, you also consume the bowl for +2 hunger.

valor.Name: V.I.O.L.E.T.
valor.Description:
Per Piece: +0.5 Block Interaction Range

Set Bonus (3+ Pieces):
- You can sneak right click with a set piece on any block with an inventory to Tether to it. 
- Activating your chestplate opens the tethered inventory.
- Activating the helmet cycles your inventory contents 1 row up.
- Activating the boots cycles them 1 row down.

valor.Name: Fermentation Barrel
valor.Description: Harvesting crops periodically grants a Potion of Luck II.

valor.Name: Treat Bag
valor.Description: Hostile mobs have a 3.33% chance to drop treats. Eating treats grants 1 hunger.
